scores.tell: Thick, rounded rim of clock is a bit puffy, but flat face and thin hands are fine.
Hat crown is lumpy and soft. The brim is a thin cream rim, but the form is toy-like.
Anchor arms and ring are thickened and rounded like inflated tubes. Flukes are soft. The rope is chunky.
Clock case is a puffy, thick rounded bezel and the body bulges out. Hands are thin.
Glass is tapered with a thick base. Umbrella and straw are fine. Slight blobbiness in the ice.
Seahorse is a well-formed, smooth stylized silhouette, with thin fins and a tight curled tail. It matches the real cards. Very minor tell: none.
Ball is a perfect sphere with a plump cap. The form is simple and generic but has no flat parts to check.
Locker has flat planar faces, tight corners, thin hinges and handle, and all expected parts present. None.
Clock bezel is a swollen pillow ring and the case is thick. The hands are thin.
Anchor ring, stock and arms are fattened sausages with balloon-like ends. The rope is thick. Overall inflated.
